name: bolt.diy
official_status_notes: Open-source (MIT) community evolution of bolt.new: prompt, run, edit, and deploy full-stack web apps in the browser (WebContainers) using your choice of LLM/provider (many providers plus Ollama); Electron desktop builds; WebContainer API needs a commercial license in production (verified Sep 2026).
license: MIT (code); WebContainer API license applies in production
pricing_summary: Free, open source; you bring the model keys (or run local models).
best_for: Self-hosting a bolt.new-style app builder with your own model keys, including local models.
strengths: Open source; any-LLM BYOK including Ollama; runs in the browser.
weaknesses: Community-maintained; model quality varies; commercial WebContainer licensing.
